text:
Rule #1

If my boss says "quick call," I'm already updating my résumé.

My boss said "we're a family here."

Great. So I can ignore your calls on holidays too.
Nothing builds team spirit like a two-hour meeting that could've been one email.

Rule #2

If you book a meeting at 4:59 on a Friday, you lose the right to comment on my face.

Me: does the work.
My boss: presents the work.
Also me: nodding like a proud parent who wasn't invited to the graduation.
"Per my last email" is just "please read" wearing business casual.

My boss has an open door policy.

The door is open. The mind is not.

Do I like my job? Yes.
Do I like my coworkers? Most of them.
Do I like hearing "let's circle back"?
I would rather go through the trash. Professionally.
TODAY IS NATIONAL LEAVE YOUR BOSS ON READ AFTER 6 PM DAY
Unpaid overtime is just volunteering for a company that would replace you by Friday.

"Got a quick question?"

Sir, it's never quick. And it's never one question.

"You'll wear many hats here."

Cool. Which one comes with the second paycheck?
